rationale: The stock is trading at the absolute top of its intraday range (99.5% position) after a massive gap-down and subsequent V-shaped recovery, creating significant risk of mean reversion or exhaustion at the highs. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward profile due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of immediate overhead resistance to define a clear take-profit target, while shorting into a strong momentum rally with positive news flow is counter-trend.
